commands.repo.canary.description: Run a NEW image next to the stable one and split live traffic between them by percentage (release ladder rung 2). Creates one canary Deployment + Service on the SAME live data (no fork: canary users on forked data would read stale data and write into a doomed copy) and tells the Rediacc proxy to route the given percent of the stable hostname's traffic to it. Weight 0 keeps the canary dark; weight 100 is the blue/green flip. Before every canary change, an automatic group snapshot of the cluster's datastores is taken (release ladder rung 0) as the universal undo. Schema compatibility between the two versions (expand-contract) is the application's responsibility. For schema-BREAKING releases, use blue/green instead: fork the repo (instant, includes data), point the fork's Service here with weight 100, and roll back by restarting the untouched parent; writes made after the flip exist only in the new copy, so the rollback window is a policy decision.

commands.repo.replicate.description: Create N read replicas of a repository in seconds, regardless of database size. Takes ONE datastore snapshot, then makes N constant-time fork-attaches (copy-on-write, throwaway local writes) spread across the cluster's nodes, and applies a generated overlay: one pinned PersistentVolume per replica, a StatefulSet, and two Services ({repo}-rw to the primary, {repo}-ro across the replicas). Replicas are POINT-IN-TIME copies: no replication stream, no read-your-writes; each replica runs one crash-recovery pass before serving. Refresh them with 'repo replicate refresh'. options.remoteFileUpload: 要上传到的单个远程文件路径（相对于仓库根目录）。与 --remote 互斥。
options.remotePath: 仓库内的远程子目录路径
options.renetPath: renet 二进制文件的路径（默认：PATH 中的 renet）
options.repository: 仓库名称（连接到仓库环境）
options.resetHome: 重置每个仓库的主目录覆盖层以全新开始
options.saveAs: 将凭证保存到命名上下文
options.saveKnownHosts: 测试成功后将 known_hosts 保存到机器保险箱
options.searchQueue: 在任务 ID、团队、机器、网桥中搜索
options.skipRouterRestart: 二进制更新后跳过重启路由服务器
options.sshPassword: 用于初始身份验证的 SSH 密码
options.switch: 创建后切换到此上下文
options.tfaCode: 用于验证的当前双因素认证代码
options.urlOnly: 打印 VS Code URI 而不是启动
options.vaultContent: 保险箱内容为 JSON 字符串
options.vaultJson: 保险箱内容为 JSON 字符串
options.vaultJsonMachine: 机器保险箱数据为 JSON 字符串
options.vaultVersion: 用于乐观锁定的当前保险箱版本
options.verifyChecksum: 同步后使用校验和验证文件
options.vscodeBrowser: 从仓库沙盒内提供浏览器 VS Code（无需在本地安装 VS Code）
options.vscodeNoOpen: 输出 URL 而不启动本地浏览器
options.vscodeServerArchive: 机器上预先暂存的服务器压缩包路径（离线安装）
options.vscodeServerProvider: 浏览器 VS Code 服务器实现（openvscode、code-server）
